messages:
alex: Heads-up — I just noticed a quickstart README snippet that suggests echoing the API key to /tmp and then cat'ing it into a curl command. That's a clipboard/logging/leak risk, especially for folks copying examples into terminals.
marta: ugh, where exactly?
alex: docs/dev/quickstart.md, under 'Try it locally' — it has this:
```
echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY > /tmp/redwood_token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $(cat /tmp/redwood_token)\" -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
samir: yikes. That pattern encourages writing keys to disk and accidentally checking them into screenshots or logs. We should swap to a safer example that uses an env var directly (or the CLI login flow) and show how to load from a .env file but never echo to files.
docs-qa: Agreed. I'll draft a PR to replace the snippet with something like:
```
# set in your shell (do NOT paste real keys in public places)
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-REDACTED"

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'
```
and add a short callout: "Do not paste real API keys into public repos, screenshots, or shared terminals. Use .env (gitignored) or the Redwood CLI to manage credentials."
marta: also update the onboarding cheatsheet and sample-app README — there's a 1-line example in samples/echo-bot/README that mirrors the bad pattern.
devbot: lint-snippets: found 2 occurrences of 'echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY >' in repo (docs/dev/quickstart.md, samples/echo-bot/README)
alex: cool, thanks devbot. docs-qa can you add a short note about avoiding `cat` in examples and mention token rotation/expiration best practices? maybe link to security checklist.
docs-qa: yes, will add a security note and tests. I'll include a simple unit in our docs smoke test that fails if a snippet writes to /tmp or prints "sk-" literal patterns.
amir: (typo) meant samir ^^
samir: np. assign me to review the PR once it's up. I'd like to add a tiny bash-safe wrapper that reads from env and refuses to run if the var contains 'REDACTED' so newcomers don't accidentally copy placeholder tokens.
alex: plan: docs-qa opens PR, updates quickstart + sample app + onboarding cheatsheet, adds lint rule. marta to update sample app. samir to review. I'll follow up with a short announcement in #general so new signups see the updated guidance.
marta: I'll also audit other quick snippets for similar patterns (docker examples, CI examples). Found one in .github/workflows/test.yml that echoes keys into env — will fix.
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:
